items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: this is the Marks Brothers theaters; two Marks Brothers owned The Granada and The Marlboro Theaters

ctx.x: The shows changed what--- every week---

Yes - a new show every week. And, uh, the only time--- now this is only two theaters you see. In other words, this is the Marks Brothers theaters; two Marks Brothers owned The Granada and The Marlboro Theaters and, so, they had another band called 'Charlie Kaley', who would be in our place the following week but every week, we'd have a different line of girls and a complete different show - all the great stars that you can think of. All the great moving stars and all the great comedians---
Did you move back and forth between the theaters or you just primarily stayed in one theater--
